description:
Operators today can only discover release prerequisites by calling `releases start` and reading the failure. That wastes the advisory lock, allocates a failed `releases` row (which then collides with retries), and gives no opportunity to fix prerequisites before committing to a release.

Add a read-only preflight endpoint that runs every prerequisite check WITHOUT allocating a release or acquiring the advisory lock, and returns a structured gap report keyed by the typed error codes introduced in `deployment-manager-release-typed-remediation-errors`. The skill can call preflight, walk the operator through fixes, and only call `start` once everything is green.

Scope of work:
- New handler `POST /api/v1/profiles/{id}/releases/preflight` in releases/handlers.go. Request body mirrors StartRequest (commit, version, channel, platforms optional). Response: {ready: bool, gates: [{name, code, ready, message, remediation_hint, remediation_command}]}.
- Runs: LPBS config present check, required-platforms match request, approval gate for commit, cloud-health probe, LPBS /deploy-readiness call.
- Does NOT: acquire advisory lock, insert releases rows, call scenario-to-desktop, call /verify.
- Register route in server/routes.go alongside existing release routes.
- New CLI verb `deployment-manager releases preflight <profile-id> --commit <sha> --version <ver> [--channel <ch>] [--platforms <csv>]` in cli/releases/commands.go. `--json` supported. Default human rendering shows a checklist with pass/fail + remediation per gate.
- Test matrix: every gate exercised (missing config, un-gated commit, S2C unreachable, readiness storage/app/profile failures, all-green).

Out of scope:
- Skill rewrite to call preflight (separate item).
- Interactive remediation UI.
- Preflight as part of `releases start` itself (kept separate so start can still be called directly when operator knows prereqs are met).
name: deployment-manager-release-preflight-endpoint
title: Add releases preflight Endpoint And CLI
